explanation: The eternal source of all truth and love that remains unchanged through all ages, even as people change.
The concept describing God's nature as having no limitations in time or space, emphasizing his constant presence.
The deepest and self-sacrificing care between God and humanity, as well as the Christian community that should be visible to all.
One of the central messages in the chapter about welcoming strangers with open hearts, since some have received angels without knowing it.
The holy bond between man and woman that should be honored and kept pure by all believers.
The concept that Christian faith is not built on human rules or ritual sacrifices, but on God's grace through Christ.
Acts of gratitude and goodness that God looks upon with favor instead of the old animal sacrifices from temple worship.
The quality of following one's leaders and teaching, which ensures that the community stays united and grows.
